commits.subject: nib (SMB-ILLUSTRATOR-TOOLS-2 slice 1): arrange, envelope/warp, art/scatter/pattern brushes
folio (SMB-ILLUSTRATOR-TOOLS-2 slice 2): swatches, brushes and envelopes as vector records
composite (SMB-ILLUSTRATOR-TOOLS-2 slice 3): brushed strokes and envelopes in the Folio adapter
harness (SMB-ILLUSTRATOR-TOOLS-2 slice 4): swatches, arrange, transforms, envelopes, brushes, graphic styles

capabilities_done: (1) folio StudioSwatch hsk.studio.swatch@1 (SSWT; process|global|spot|tint|gradient; RGB/CMYK/LAB/GRAY components with ranges; spot ink with measured Lab and alternate space; tint of a colour swatch) and StudioSwatchPaint (PAINT row -> swatch, per-use tint) in StudioVectorRecords, serde-default and byte-identical; harness swatches are these records (links persist across save/reopen), CMYK (caller CMYK ICC on VectorTool::cmyk_profile, machine-local) and Lab resolved through Prism WideEngine into the CC0 sRGB v4 profile; spot via measured Lab else alternate; tints scale toward paper in the source model; editing a swatch rewrites every bound row and the rows of its tints in ONE undo step; companion PAINT style per swatch for network region fills

(2) nib::arrange align (selection, key object, artboard; edges and centres) and distribute (edges/centres; equal or explicit spacing from the key object); harness align_layers / distribute_layers move all layers in ONE step (new Run::set_vector_paths_and_entry: one chronicle patch of several vector_paths writes plus the entry in one history step)

(3) nib::arrange rotate/scale/reflect/shear about a point, exact path bounds, transform_each (STU-VEC-157 parameter ranges, nine-position reference point, seeded randomize); harness transform_layers (about a reference point of the selection bounds) and transform_each_layers; handles and network tangents by the linear part, mesh-envelope points moved too

(4) nib::warp envelope_paths: the fifteen STU-VEC-168 warp styles (Studio formulas, ratios, axis, horizontal/vertical distortion), mesh grids (bilinear) and top-object Coons patches, fidelity -> tolerance; folio StudioEnvelope; composite wraps the path geometry before the appearance or, with distort_appearance, the drawn geometry, consumes a top-object layer and refuses distort_*_fills typed; harness make (warp/mesh/top object), move mesh point, release, expand (bake)

(5) nib::brush art (proportional, stretch, between guides, flips), scatter (fixed or seeded random size/spacing/offset/rotation, page or path relative) and pattern brushes (side/start/end/outer/inner corner tiles, stretch or add-space fit); folio StudioVectorBrush (five kinds, STU-VEC-152 ranges, STU-VEC-150 dynamics with max) and StudioBrushStroke; composite draws one own-geometry row per art path (colorize none or tints); harness add_brush from layer art, apply_brush (scale override), remove_brush

(6) graphic styles (STU-VEC-024) as published PAINT styles a layer node links to: add from layer, apply (linked), redefine (linked layers follow), break link (local copy), additive merge, clear appearance, reduce to basic; swatch and brush bindings follow every restyle by row kind and ordinal

notes.retry_guard: route (a) twice: folio vector_tools fixture (top object must be unwrapped) committed in 78a237c before the rerun; harness swatch ids used an invalid UUID variant nibble (d000/c000 -> 8000/b000) fixed and committed in 18320c8 before the rerun (the gameplan hook blocked the uncommitted rerun). No gameplan step added
gaps: swatch kinds mixed_ink / mixed_ink_group, swatch groups, reserved swatches and palette scopes not modelled; gradient stops cannot reference swatches; a spot without measured Lab or alternate is refused at creation (no screen colour)
CMYK profile is a machine-local VectorTool field (not resolved from the document working_space_cmyk SCPF); GRAY swatches map g -> (g, g, g) without a gray profile

warp formulas, brush layout rules, transform-each randomize and the nine-position reference integer mapping are Studio rules (Illustrator parity UNVERIFIED, D5); captured warp integer mapping not recorded

composite does not distort gradient or pattern paints (distort_* refused typed); expand_envelope refuses networks and distort_appearance envelopes; a top-object layer is consumed (drawn empty) rather than deleted
calligraphic and bristle brushes are records only (composite refuses them typed); colorize tints_and_shades and hue_shift refused; stylus dynamics use the parameter value
graphic styles are document-local (no cross-document libraries); 'new art inherits appearance' toggle not modelled
